case_results.question: How many days of annual leave are full-time employees entitled to per calendar year?
case_results.agent_response:
Full-time employees are entitled to 20 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accruing at 1.67 days per month.
[Source: leave_policy.pdf, Page: 1]

case_results.question: What is the maximum number of annual leave days that can be carried over to the following year?
case_results.agent_response:
Employees may carry over a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year, which must be utilized prior to March 31.
[Source: leave_policy.pdf, Page: 1]

case_results.question: When is a medical certificate required for sick leave?
case_results.agent_response:
An official medical certificate from a registered physician is mandatory for any sick leave exceeding two (2) consecutive working days.
[Source: leave_policy.pdf, Page: 1]

case_results.question: What are the standard core working hours and office opening times?
case_results.agent_response:
Standard office hours are 08:30 to 17:30 Monday through Friday. Mandatory core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 16:00.
[Source: attendance_policy.pdf, Page: 1]

case_results.question: What is the grace period for late arrivals before an employee is marked tardy?
failure_reasons: hallucination: Response contains assertions partially ungrounded in retrieved context.
case_results.agent_response:
A 15-minute grace period allows arrival up to 08:45 without formal penalty at most twice per calendar month.
[Source: attendance_policy.pdf, Page: 1]

case_results.question: How long is the standard employee probation period according to the handbook?
case_results.agent_response:
All newly hired employees undergo a standard probationary evaluation period of three (3) months, extendable by up to an additional three months.
[Source: employee_handbook.pdf, Page: 1]

case_results.question: Can an employee take paid annual leave during their initial 3-month probation period?
case_results.agent_response:
During the initial 3-month probation period, employees accrue annual leave but cannot take paid vacation days until successful confirmation.
[Source: leave_policy.pdf, Page: 1] [Source: employee_handbook.pdf, Page: 1]

case_results.question: How many days of paid compassionate / bereavement leave are granted for the loss of an immediate family member?
case_results.agent_response:
Up to five (5) consecutive paid working days are granted for bereavement in the event of the loss of an immediate family member.
[Source: leave_policy.pdf, Page: 1]

case_results.question: What is the procedure if an employee is absent without prior notice or approved leave?
case_results.agent_response:
Absence from work for three (3) consecutive working days without authorized communication is deemed voluntary job abandonment and constitutes grounds for termination.
[Source: attendance_policy.pdf, Page: 1] [Source: employee_handbook.pdf, Page: 1]

case_results.question: What are the formal stages of the progressive disciplinary policy?
case_results.agent_response:
The progressive disciplinary framework consists of: 1) Verbal Counseling, 2) Written Warning, 3) Final Written Warning with 30-day PIP, and 4) Termination.
[Source: employee_handbook.pdf, Page: 1]
